生成された動画：=== RIVEN CHARACTER REFERENCE ===

Use the provided Riven character reference as the visual reference for Riven.

Keep the established Riven character design shown in the reference:
pale-blonde hair,
hairstyle,
fantasy clothing and armor,
sword,
and overall warrior appearance.

Riven remains visually consistent throughout the entire video.

Keep her original costume, equipment, and sword design unchanged.

This scene takes place many years after Riven's childhood.

She has spent years practicing swordsmanship with her father and is now a highly capable young warrior.

She has not yet experienced real warfare.

Her swordsmanship is disciplined, controlled, and grounded.

No supernatural abilities.

No magical effects.

Riven does not speak.


=== FATHER CHARACTER REFERENCE ===

Use the provided Father character reference for Riven's father.

Keep his established face, hair, beard, clothing, and overall appearance consistent.

He is a former warrior and Riven's father.

He has watched Riven train for many years.

Their relationship is quiet, familiar, and natural.

He does not speak in this scene.


=== ENVIRONMENT ===

Use the provided village and family cottage reference as the visual foundation for the location.

The scene takes place beside Riven's family cottage in the same peaceful medieval-fantasy mountain village where she grew up.

Keep the recognizable cottage, old tree, dirt-and-grass training area, firewood, village road, green valley, and distant mountains.

Soft natural daylight.

Gentle mountain wind.

Subtle chimney smoke.

Quiet rural life.

The village feels peaceful and safe.

A dirt road runs naturally through the village near the cottage.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Grounded medieval-fantasy world.

Natural human movement.

Realistic sword weight and momentum.

Realistic footwork.

Realistic cloth and hair physics.

Natural cinematic camera movement.

Patient pacing.

Restrained editing.

No rapid montage.

No age transformation.

Do not show Child Riven.

Riven is already grown when the video begins.

No exaggerated acrobatics.

No spinning attacks.

No supernatural movement.

No magical sword effects.

No dialogue.

No narration.

No voice-over.

No intelligible background conversations.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No visible text.

No watermark.

No logo.

Natural audio only:

gentle wind,
birds,
quiet village ambience,
boots against dirt,
sword cutting through air,
Riven's controlled breathing,
distant horse hooves,
subtle movement of armor and equipment.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Open directly on a cinematic medieval-fantasy sword-training sequence.

Riven is already practicing alone in the dirt-and-grass area beside her family cottage.

Her father stands nearby, quietly observing.

The contrast with her childhood should be immediately clear through movement alone.

Riven now handles her sword naturally.

Her stance is stable.

Her footwork is precise.

Her attacks are controlled.

Her recovery after each movement is clean.

She has repeated these movements for years.

She performs a short practical sequence and finishes in complete balance.

Her father watches silently.

There is no correction.

There is no instruction.

Riven no longer needs either.

Then distant horse hooves become audible.

Riven hears them.

She stops training and looks toward the village road.

A small group of medieval-fantasy soldiers is traveling through the village.

They are disciplined professional soldiers passing peacefully through the area.

They do not threaten anyone.

Riven watches them.

Her attention is especially drawn to their weapons, armor, disciplined formation, and confident movement.

For Riven, they represent a world beyond the small village where she has spent her entire life.

She looks briefly at the sword in her own hand.

Then she looks back toward the departing soldiers.

Her father notices.

He stops watching the soldiers and instead watches his daughter.

He understands what has captured her attention.

Riven does not notice him watching.

No one speaks.

Riven does not follow the soldiers.

End with Riven silently watching them leave the village.


=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — YEARS LATER

Begin with a cinematic close-up of Riven's sword moving through the air.

The blade passes through frame with controlled speed.

Reveal Riven in the familiar training area beside her family cottage.

She is already in motion.

Adult Riven performs a short sequence of grounded swordsmanship.

A controlled diagonal cut.

She immediately recovers into a stable stance.

She shifts her feet.

A second precise movement.

She changes direction naturally and brings the sword under control.

Every movement should feel practiced rather than improvised.

The sword has believable physical weight.

Riven uses her entire body correctly to control its momentum.

Do not make the sequence flashy.

Do not make Riven struggle with the sword.

Do not make her lose balance.

She finishes the sequence cleanly.

Her breathing remains controlled.

Hold briefly on Riven standing with the sword.

Reveal her father nearby.

He has been watching quietly.

He does not correct her.

He does not need to.

This simple visual should communicate that the child he once taught has grown into a highly capable swordswoman.

Then:

distant horse hooves.

Riven hears them.

Her eyes shift toward the sound.

She lowers the sword slightly.

CUT.


Shot 2 — THE ROAD BEYOND HOME

Move naturally with Riven's gaze toward the village road.

A small group of medieval-fantasy soldiers travels through the peaceful village.

Some walk beside their horses.

Others may ride slowly.

Their armor is practical and weathered.

Their swords and equipment move naturally with their bodies.

Their formation is disciplined without being ceremonial.

They are clearly accustomed to traveling together.

The soldiers are peaceful.

They are not invading the village.

They are not threatening anyone.

Villagers continue their ordinary routines around them.

The soldiers simply pass through on their journey.

Show the group primarily from Riven's perspective.

Riven watches their disciplined movement.

Her attention moves across:

their worn armor,

their real weapons,

their horses,

their controlled formation,

their confidence as people who have traveled far beyond this valley.

Do not portray the moment as ominous.

To Riven, this is fascinating.

It is a glimpse of a larger world.

CUT.


Shot 3 — SOMETHING CHANGES

Return to Riven.

She stands completely still in the training area.

Her sword is lowered naturally beside her.

The soldiers continue farther along the road in the background.

Riven follows them with her eyes.

Her expression is subtle and thoughtful.

She is not smiling broadly.

She is not suddenly excited.

She is simply unable to look away.

Riven slowly looks down at the sword in her own hand.

Hold briefly.

The sword she has spent years learning to use now means something different.

Riven raises her eyes again.

She looks toward the soldiers disappearing farther down the road beyond the village.

Gentle wind moves her pale-blonde hair and clothing.

Now reveal her father.

He initially looks toward the departing soldiers.

Then his attention moves to Riven.

He watches her quietly.

He sees the way she is looking beyond the village.

He understands.

Do not make him sad yet.

Do not make him smile.

Do not make the moment sentimental.

He simply realizes that his daughter is beginning to look beyond the life she has always known.

Riven does not notice him watching.

The soldiers continue away.

No dialogue.

No additional action.

Hold on Riven with the village road extending beyond her.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven remains beside her family cottage with her sword in hand.

Her father stands nearby.

The traveling soldiers are disappearing along the road beyond the village.

Riven silently watches them leave.

She has not joined them.

She has not followed them.

She has not announced any decision.

But something has changed.

For the first time, Riven is seriously looking beyond her home toward the wider world.

Her father notices this before she says anything.

End in silence.


=== MOOD ===

Warm.

Grounded.

Reflective.

Quietly ambitious.

The scene is about transition rather than action.

The audience should understand the passage of time without being told:

the little girl who once struggled to control a sword
has grown into someone who can wield one naturally.

The emotional progression is simple:

Riven trains with confidence
→ distant horse hooves interrupt her
→ soldiers pass through the village
→ Riven becomes fascinated
→ she looks at her own sword
→ she looks beyond the village
→ her father notices.

Do not add another story event.

Do not have Riven speak.

Do not have her father speak.

Do not have Riven approach the soldiers.

Do not have the soldiers recruit her.

Do not turn the soldiers into villains.

Do not make Riven leave home yet.

That decision belongs later.

End only with the first clear desire to see the world beyond the village.、16:9
